subject: ENERCOM S.r.l.

decision.reason: Current public evidence confirms Enercom-owned public charging infrastructure, but activation is via EVWay / interoperable MSPs rather than a published deterministic Enercom direct/ad-hoc network tariff. No national/class-wide direct tariff may be inferred.
decision.resumeCondition: Reconcile the current PUN partyId/EVSE IDs for ENERCOM, then obtain a deterministic direct/ad-hoc price from an Enercom-controlled QR/payment surface or a first-party station/backend payload. EVWay prices must remain eMSP/roaming unless a station-specific direct-CPO relationship is proven.

positiveEvidence.source: Comune di Crema - Colonnine di ricarica auto
positiveEvidence.finding: Lists four Enercom Quick stations in Crema; charging activation is via EVWay, while other interoperable MSPs may also be used.
Confirms new Enercom public stations in 2026 and states the local Enercom network had reached ten installed columns.

positiveEvidence.source: Adiconsum May 2026 PUN CPO inventory snapshot
positiveEvidence.finding: ENERCOM S.r.l. appears as a distinct PUN CPO with 14/14 active/total charging points in the January 2026 inventory snapshot.

negativeEvidence: No current first-party Enercom Italy public-EV tariff grid was found.
Enercom household/business electricity prices are commodity supply tariffs and are prohibited as EV charging prices.
The similarly named Portuguese mobility.enercom.pt service is a different market/entity context and is excluded.
EVWay is an MSP/interoperability activation surface in the municipal documentation; its retail price cannot be promoted as Enercom direct CPO pricing without deterministic proof.
antiRepeat: Do not search again for a generic Enercom national tariff unless new first-party evidence appears.
Do not transpose Enercom electricity-supply tariffs to charging.
Do not use Portuguese Enercom mobility tariffs for Italy.
Next useful investigation is partyId/EVSE reconciliation followed by station QR/backend/direct-payment mapping.

canonicalImpact.reason: The current canonical is still incomplete nominatively (41/92 current PUN partyIds named). ENERCOM's current 2026-09 partyId has not yet been deterministically recovered, so no subtraction from the 51 unreconciled partyIds is safe.
canonicalImpact.expectedFutureClassification: partial/station-level once partyId is deterministically reconciled
